open_pull_requests.title: Cache proofing waves and selection bands across repaints
open_pull_requests.body: Proofing wave paths and text-selection band paths are immutable for the same line/selection geometry, so reuse them across repaints instead of rebuilding every frame.

open_pull_requests.title: Preserve native Zotero round trips through LibreOffice [skip ci]
open_pull_requests.body:
## Why

Native editable ODT exports can retain Zotero metadata through a LibreOffice save while still failing to reopen in Quds. The frozen current-main reproduction identifies bibliography section styles, note offset conventions and table-width semantics as concrete gaps.

## Changes in progress

- Admit only inert inherited bibliography section styles and validate unused sequence declarations.
- Qualify the identified LibreOffice decimal note-offset convention against exact visible ordinals.
- Preserve fixed table widths with physical alignment on the explicit editable Zotero export path.
- Retain actual converter fixtures and regression checks for active field edits, repeated saves and unlinking.

The initial intake accounts for all 375 captured refs: 361 ancestors and 14 independently verified historical equivalents. All current branch tips and upstream heads are included in the baseline.

## Validation status

Initial combined local checks passed 1,415 engine cases across 71 files and 108 editor cases across six files, with no failures/skips and unchanged captured inputs. Follow-up actual file cycles exposed a DOCX uniform table-padding omission and an ODF soft-page-break hint; their fixes and final combined qualification are in progress. These initial counts are not a claim about final source.

The converter is LibreOfficeDev 26.8.0.0.alpha0, build 2c87e51eeaa2b413ff4ae097b2705eea1995d8e5. Actual installed Zotero plugin/release-host acceptance and active footnote separator geometry remain separate boundaries.

User-authorized delivery uses incremental remote checkpoints and a normal merge to main after local validation. GitHub Actions are not queried or awaited; no protection changes or remote history rewrites are used.

Work record: docs/validation/zotero-odt-roundtrip-20261121/README.md

other_heads.disposition: Preserve separately; exact-head work record says implementation and final combined-source qualification are in progress. Earlier 1206 engine, 19 editor and 143 Studio passes predate reader/writer/deserializer/table changes and the draft Zotero integration at this head.
